name: Ferdows
source: Ferdows is a young male Yazata who highly respects [url=https://vndb.org/c111533]Magsarion[/url] and is concurrent with [url=https://vndb.org/c111534]Quinn[/url]. In a general sense, he is a harsh pessimist, but follows the essence of pure, old-styled chivalry.
